name: NYAS Serious Games for Crisis Preparedness (Disaster Response Game + Volcanic Eruption Game)
description: This benchmark evaluates scientific decision-making under crisis conditions through two linked serious games: rapid response to emerging disasters (wildfires, hurricanes, food security) and global coordination following a major volcanic eruption disrupting supply chains.
reputation: Innovative serious games from the New York Academy of Sciences' International Science Reserve for training global scientific crisis response
notes: Free digital serious games emphasizing incomplete information and shifting conditions; excellent for testing high-stakes scientific and policy judgment

institutions: New York Academy of Sciences (International Science Reserve)
